main_text.l: EPIST. V.
Hier. Aleander viro Doct. J. Morino de
variis exemplaribus, nec non Charact-
eribus Samaritanorum.

l.i: Viro Doctissimo & Religiosissimo Jo. Morino, Hier. Aleander S. D.

main_text.l: SErius qvidem tuæ ad me literæ perve-
nerunt pridie idus Martias datæ, qvip-
pe illas superiore tantum hebdomada ac-
cepi; verùm adeo jucundæ fuerunt, ut
nihil accidere mihi jucundius optatius-
qve posset; cum præter non obscura tui
in me amoris indicia, doctissimam Præ-
fationem afferrent in novam istam vete-
ris Testamenti à LXX. translati editio-
nem:qva sane Præfatione nihil eruditius,
accuratius nihil concinnari poterat.
Eam ego statim devoravi, non legi, adeo
hujusmodi epularum sum avidus; ac
tam svavi sacræ doctrinæ, ut ita loqvar,
lucco imbutum me sensi, ut mirifica
qvadam voluptate totus sim perfusus.
Qvamobrem, qvod participem hujusce
dissertationis facere me volueris, valde

page.notes: Long s is rendered as s throughout, including "dissertationis" (appears as "dillertationis" in the scan). "lucco" in "lucco imbutum" is a clear reading of the scan's blurred word, but the spacing is uncertain. "jucundæ" and "Præfatione" are read from a soft scan with the æ ligature; the ligature is not fully sharp. No marginal notes, no reference marks, no damage affecting the main text.
